column1: ## The accessions that count as HEAT evidence in the final TOR N-terminal HEAT call.
## Source: 06_tor_heat/final_calls/resolve_heat_final.py, function evi_class (lines 94 to 105). This file is a
## transcription of that function; the function remains the authority.
## Rule: HEAT_PRESENT if at least one accession of class A, B or C overlaps the N-terminal region by at least one
## residue; otherwise HEAT_ABSENT, meaning the region was evaluated and no HEAT-indicative evidence was found.
## Tier: class A or B gives HIGH; class C from both SUPERFAMILY and Gene3D gives MODERATE; class C from one of them
## gives LOW. A weak E-value (above 1e-5) on class A or B evidence lowers the tier by one step. FunFam is counted
## with Gene3D, not as a separate database.
## The accessions admitted are also listed in HEAT_EVIDENCE_RULES.tsv, which the script reads and requires to be
## non-empty; that file is in the data deposit, not in this repository.

column5: repeat-fold annotation, any FunFam family under G3DSA:1.25.10.10
